_about: The Verdant Dump (Refusemancer). Golden-hour sunset, rusted metal, mossy wood, patchwork panels. The corruption block is the gradient toward the Rotheart (HeapLayout.corruption_at, 0 healthy .. 1 at the roots): the ground lerps toward the tint and darkens and the corrupted soil (DUMP-GROUND-CORRUPT) paints in up to `texture`; healthy vine oaks and tyre birches give way to twisted trees from `trees` (a soft band `trees_band` wide), wildflower beds to violet fungus from `fungus`, flowers thin to `flowers`; `grade` and `light` are what the look reaches at full corruption where the hero stands (fog, saturation, warmth, vignette; the sun lower and violet, the ambient violet), blended by HeapScene; `freed` scales all of it once the zone is freed (the Rotheart glows green).
name: The Verdant Dump (Refusemancer)
time_of_day: Golden-hour sunset; warm haze, long shadows, fireflies
